snippet.title: Exit The Abyss | Full Walkthrough | Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
Exit the Abyss is a psychological horror game set in a desolate, abandoned hospital. Players control a young man who, after his death, finds himself trapped in an alternate version of the hospital after activating a mysterious switch. To return to the world of the living, he must endure a series of harrowing and mentally exhausting trials.

The game focuses on psychological tension and an oppressive atmosphere, immersing players in an eerie, unsettling environment. Each challenge is designed to evoke fear and unease, pushing players forward as they progress through the hospital’s sinister halls.

Atmospheric Psychological Horror – Exit the Abyss builds a constant sense of dread, immersing players in a dark and oppressive world.

Exploration-Based Progression – Instead of complex puzzles, the game emphasizes navigating disturbing environments and overcoming psychological trials.

Minimalist Yet Haunting Visuals – The art style enhances the emotional intensity, reinforcing the feeling of isolation and fear.

Environmental Storytelling – No dialogues, human voices, or crying children—everything unfolds through atmosphere, unsettling events, and hidden details.
